defs.def: the rate at which sb/sth moves or travels （运动的）速度，速率

ex.s: What did the horse think, as he sped through the night?
ex.t: 那匹马在黑夜中疾驰时会想些什么呢？

ex.s: What did the horse think, as he sped through the night?
ex.t: 那匹马在黑夜中疾驰时会想些什么呢？

ex.s: （30分）I was ready to pay for my bananas at the grocery one night， when fear seized me． My wallet was gone． I could only have left it on the G9 bus， which was now speeding in the dark to some（1）     station．
ex.t: 16．（30分）一天晚上我准备在杂货店付香蕉的钱时，恐惧突然袭来。我的钱包不见了。我只能把它落在了G9公交车上，而那辆车此刻正飞驰在黑暗中驶向某个（1）     站。

ex.s: Despite a weight of up to 300 kilograms, they can run at a speed of around 64 kilometers per hour and are also excellent swimmers.
ex.t: 尽管体重可达 300 公斤，它们的奔跑速度仍能达到每小时约 64 公里，而且也是出色的游泳者。

ex.s: It has a digital display that records your steps, speed and distance, as well as monitoring your heart rate and calories burnt.
ex.t: 它有一个数字显示屏，记录你的步数、速度和距离，同时监测你的心率和消耗的卡路里。

ex.s: It was so wonderful to be part of this sporting moment and enjoy its speed and passion.
ex.t: 成为这个体育时刻的一部分，享受它的速度和激情真是太棒了。

ex.s: They seem totally unaware that we are speeding past at over 100 kilometres an hour.
ex.t: 他们似乎完全不知道我们以每小时100公里的速度超速通过。

ex.s: Unable to distinguish between blue sky and glass, birds crash into windows at speeds of about 30 miles per hour.
ex.t: 由于无法区分蓝天和玻璃，鸟类以大约每小时30英里的速度撞向窗户。

ex.s: To calculate your speed as you do, divide 3,600(the number of seconds in an hour)by the number of seconds it takes you to travel one mile(the distance between two mileposts).
ex.t: 要计算你的速度，像你那样，用3600（一小时的秒数）除以你走一英里（两个里程标之间的距离）所花的秒数。

ex.s: This allows it to take in air at 30 times the speed of a human sneeze, enabling it to drink 3L of water a second.
ex.t: 这使得它以人类喷嚏速度的30倍的速度在空气中摄取，使其能一秒饮用3L的水。

ex.s: If the only reading you ever do is the novel or magazine, the speed at which you read -probably does not matter very much.
ex.t: 如果你唯一的阅读就是小说或杂志，那么你阅读的速度可能并不太重要。

ex.s: Here are some tips to help improve your reading speed.
ex.t: 这里有一些帮助你提高阅读速度的建议。

ex.s: “Only if we discuss the consequences of our biophysical limits” the December warning letter says, “can we have the hope to reduce their speed, severity and harm”.
ex.t: "只有当我们讨论我们生物物理极限的后果时"12月的警告信说"我们才有希望降低其速度、严重性和危害"。

ex.s: Then, on two separate morning visits to the scientists’ lab, each man walked for an hour at an average speed that, in theory should allow his body to rely mainly on fat for fuel.
ex.t: 随后，在两次分别前往科学家实验室的早晨探访中，每名男子都以平均速度走了一小时，这个速度理论上应能让身体主要依靠脂肪供能。

ex.s: They could walk at an average speed.
ex.t: 他们能以平均速度行走。

ex.s: It'll help speed up typing.
ex.t: 它将加快打字速度。

ex.s: But compared with previous studies, she finds the speed of breaking down in this one exciting.
ex.t: 但与之前的研究相比，她发现这项研究中分解的速度令人兴奋。

ex.s: increase the breakdown speed
ex.t: 提高分解速度

defs.def: the rate at which sth happens or is done （发生或进行的）速度；进度
the quality of being quick or rapid 快；迅速
a measurement of how sensitive film for cameras, etc. is to light 感光度
the time taken by a camera shutter to open and close 快门速度
a gear on a bicycle, in a car, etc. 尤用于构成复合词
an illegal amphetamine drug that is taken to give feelings of excitement and energy 苯丙胺，安非他明（一种兴奋剂）

ex.s: We’re looking at the benefits of systems which control their speed as a way of preventing that.
ex.t: 我们正在研究控制车速的系统的好处，将其作为一种预防措施。"

defs.def: performing at an expected rate or level 人、公司等

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。

defs.def: having the most recent and accurate information or knowledge 人
to move along quickly 快速前行

ex.s: For most of the last century, the car represented what it meant to be American—going forward at high speed to find new worlds.
ex.t: 公路小说、公路电影，这些是最典型的美国观念，诞生于丰富的汽油、廉价的汽车和无尽的高速公路系统——这是历史上最大的公共工程项目。

defs.def: to take sb/sth somewhere very quickly, especially in a vehicle 快速运送

ex.s: They often run at high speeds, what may put our lives in danger.
ex.t: 它们经常高速奔跑，这可能将我们的生命置于危险之中。

defs.def: to make sth happen more quickly 加速；促进

ex.s: AI speeds up the process of human evolution.
ex.t: AI加速了人类进化的过程。

ex.s: To speed up their ripening.
ex.t: 以加速其成熟。

ex.s: The instructor kept repeating the word, “Speed up!” “Slow down!” “Turning left!” I was so much nervous that I could hardly tell which direction was left.
ex.t: 教练不停地重复这个词： “加速！“慢点！ ”“向左转！ “我非常紧张，几乎分不清剩下哪个方向。

ex.s: It should speed up its progress.
ex.t: 它应该加快发展速度。

ex.s: “We need to speed up the development of green energy, and it will all get used,” says Wipke.
ex.t: Wipke说：“我们需要加快绿色能源的发展，而它都会被用上。”

ex.s: They will speed up energy production.
ex.t: 它们可能向家庭传输电力。

ex.s: To speed up the process, please make sure the information you submit through the ILL Request Form is accurate.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画颜料的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

defs.def: to drive faster than the speed that is legally allowed 通常用于进行时
